title: GTA 6 Cars Guide: How to Steal, Keep & Pick the Best Cars
title_alternatives: How to Keep Stolen Cars in GTA 6 (Don't Lose Them)
GTA 6 Best Cars and How to Get Them
description_summary: Everything about cars in GTA 6: how to scan and steal them, trackers and key cloners, how to register a stolen car so you keep it forever, garages, and the best cars by the game's own ratings.

beats.caption: In GTA 6, stealing a car doesn't make it yours. Leave it behind, die, or quit the game, and that car is gone. So in this video: how to steal smart, how to keep a car forever, and which cars are actually worth keeping.
beats.tts: In GTA 6, stealing a car doesn't make it yours. Leave it behind, die, or quit the game, and that car is gone. So in this video: how to steal smart, how to keep a car forever, and which cars are actually worth keeping.
beats.visual_need: supercar driving through Vice City at sunset

beats.caption: We'll cover the Waink scanner, every way into a car, trackers, registering with Moses, garages, and then the best cars by the game's own ratings. Stick around, because one tracker type can bring the police straight to you.
beats.tts: We'll cover the Waink scanner, every way into a car, trackers, registering with Moses, garages, and then the best cars by the game's own ratings. Stick around, because one tracker type can bring the police straight to you.
beats.visual_need: montage of car theft, garage, police chase

beats.caption: Step one is the Waink app on your phone. Open your phone with up on the d-pad, then scan a car. It shows the car's stats, its condition, and its security, including alarms and trackers.
beats.tts: Step one is the Waink app on your phone. Open your phone with up on the d-pad, then scan a car. It shows the car's stats, its condition, and its security, including alarms and trackers.
beats.visual_need: phone in hand, parked sports car

beats.caption: It also tells you what the car sells for and what it costs to register. That one scan tells you whether a car is a quick payday, a keeper, or a waste of your time.
beats.tts: It also tells you what the car sells for and what it costs to register. That one scan tells you whether a car is a quick payday, a keeper, or a waste of your time.
beats.visual_need: luxury cars parked on a street

beats.caption: And if you're already driving, press down to check for a tracker. Get in the habit of checking before you get attached to a car.
beats.tts: And if you're already driving, press down to check for a tracker. Get in the habit of checking before you get attached to a car.

beats.caption: Two more Waink tricks most players miss. Stand near a car you've already been in and press L1 to see its engine details. And while driving, hold left on the d-pad to bring the car's info up on your screen.
beats.tts: Two more Waink tricks most players miss. Stand near a car you've already been in and press L1 to see its engine details. And while driving, hold left on the d-pad to bring the car's info up on your screen.

beats.caption: Now, getting in. First, just try the door. Some parked cars are unlocked, and that's the quietest theft in the game.
beats.tts: Now, getting in. First, just try the door. Some parked cars are unlocked, and that's the quietest theft in the game.

beats.caption: If it's locked, you can smash the window. It's fast, but it can trigger the alarm, and an alarm alerts the people nearby.
beats.tts: If it's locked, you can smash the window. It's fast, but it can trigger the alarm, and an alarm alerts the people nearby.

beats.caption: Locked cars also need hotwiring. Push both sticks together to fill the semi-circles and the engine starts. Most older cars can be hotwired.
beats.tts: Locked cars also need hotwiring. Push both sticks together to fill the semi-circles and the engine starts. Most older cars can be hotwired.

beats.caption: High-end keyless cars are different. You can't hotwire them. You need a key cloner, which unlocks later in the story through Randy, the contact who hands out high-end car contracts.
beats.tts: High-end keyless cars are different. You can't hotwire them. You need a key cloner, which unlocks later in the story through Randy, the contact who hands out high-end car contracts.

beats.caption: And of course, you can still carjack. Pull the driver out and the car is yours, at least for now.
beats.tts: And of course, you can still carjack. Pull the driver out and the car is yours, at least for now.
beats.visual_need: carjacking a driver on the street

beats.caption: Here's the trap I mentioned. There are two kinds of tracker. A standard tracker just stops you from modifying the car until it's registered to you.
beats.tts: Here's the trap I mentioned. There are two kinds of tracker. A standard tracker just stops you from modifying the car until it's registered to you.

beats.caption: An advanced tracker is the dangerous one. It's common on high-end cars, it notifies the police when the car is stolen, and it reports the car's location unless you're moving at high speed.
beats.tts: An advanced tracker is the dangerous one. It's common on high-end cars, it notifies the police when the car is stolen, and it reports the car's location unless you're moving at high speed.

beats.caption: Red Bull's guide adds that an advanced tracker pings the police once the car gets too far from where you took it. So the longer and slower your drive home, the worse it gets. Either drive fast, or don't take it in the first place.
beats.tts: Red Bull's guide adds that an advanced tracker pings the police once the car gets too far from where you took it. So the longer and slower your drive home, the worse it gets. Either drive fast, or don't take it in the first place.

beats.caption: So if you steal a tracked supercar, keep your foot down. Slow down in traffic and you're broadcasting your position.
beats.tts: So if you steal a tracked supercar, keep your foot down. Slow down in traffic and you're broadcasting your position.

beats.caption: In Chapter 1 you can still drive other cars around Leonida, just only temporarily. So enjoy them, but don't get attached until registration unlocks.
beats.tts: In Chapter 1 you can still drive other cars around Leonida, just only temporarily. So enjoy them, but don't get attached until registration unlocks.
beats.visual_need: driving different cars around the Keys

beats.caption: Now the part most people miss: keeping a car. Registration unlocks in Chapter 2, at Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn, after his introductory mission. Before that, in Chapter 1, Jason's starting car is your main personal vehicle.
beats.tts: Now the part most people miss: keeping a car. Registration unlocks in Chapter 2, at Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn, after his introductory mission. Before that, in Chapter 1, Jason's starting car is your main personal vehicle.
beats.visual_need: garage in Port Gellhorn, driving in

beats.caption: The process is simple. Drive a car without a tracker into Moses's workshop, choose Respray, pick a new colour, then choose Register. Your first registration during that mission is free, so pick a car you actually love.
beats.tts: The process is simple. Drive a car without a tracker into Moses's workshop, choose Respray, pick a new colour, then choose Register. Your first registration during that mission is free, so pick a car you actually love.
beats.visual_need: car being resprayed in a garage

beats.caption: After that, registering costs money. The Waink scan shows you the price before you steal, and cheaper cars cost less to register.
beats.tts: After that, registering costs money. The Waink scan shows you the price before you steal, and cheaper cars cost less to register.

beats.caption: Pay N Spray can register cars too, and it can sell them for cash. But depending on the tracker, some vehicles get refused.
beats.tts: Pay N Spray can register cars too, and it can sell them for cash. But depending on the tracker, some vehicles get refused.

beats.caption: Why does registering matter so much? Registered cars can be modified, and if you lose one, you can always get it back. An unregistered stolen car that gets destroyed is gone for good.
beats.tts: Why does registering matter so much? Registered cars can be modified, and if you lose one, you can always get it back. An unregistered stolen car that gets destroyed is gone for good.

beats.caption: Found something special but can't afford to register it yet? The safest move is to park it in your garage and leave it there until you have the cash. Driving it around before that puts it at risk.
beats.tts: Found something special but can't afford to register it yet? The safest move is to park it in your garage and leave it there until you have the cash. Driving it around before that puts it at risk.
beats.visual_need: parking a supercar in a garage

beats.caption: Once a car is registered, the Scooter Bros app lets you summon it any time. And your personal vehicle carries spare outfits in its trunk, which is a lifesaver when the police are looking for your clothes.
beats.tts: Once a car is registered, the Scooter Bros app lets you summon it any time. And your personal vehicle carries spare outfits in its trunk, which is a lifesaver when the police are looking for your clothes.

beats.caption: You also need space. Every registered car needs a free garage spot. Garages store your cars for free, hold your weapon loadout, and let you drop off illegal goods.
beats.tts: You also need space. Every registered car needs a free garage spot. Garages store your cars for free, hold your weapon loadout, and let you drop off illegal goods.

beats.caption: More space comes as the story moves on, including Valentina's garage later in the game. So if your slots are full, keep playing the main missions before you start selling off your favourites.
beats.tts: More space comes as the story moves on, including Valentina's garage later in the game. So if your slots are full, keep playing the main missions before you start selling off your favourites.

beats.caption: You can only buy garages after Jason and Lucia leave Key Lento, and buying every garage unlocks an achievement called Little Boxes. So start saving early if you're a collector.
beats.tts: You can only buy garages after Jason and Lucia leave Key Lento, and buying every garage unlocks an achievement called Little Boxes. So start saving early if you're a collector.

beats.caption: And for repairs and customisation there are Pay N Spray locations all over the map, nineteen of them according to MetaForge's count, so you're never far from a fix.
beats.tts: And for repairs and customisation there are Pay N Spray locations all over the map, nineteen of them according to MetaForge's count, so you're never far from a fix.

beats.caption: Now, which cars are worth a garage spot? A quick warning first: Rockstar hasn't published top speeds, so instead I'll use the speed ratings the game itself shows, as recorded by GamerBlurb.
beats.tts: Now, which cars are worth a garage spot? A quick warning first: Rockstar hasn't published top speeds, so instead I'll use the speed ratings the game itself shows, as recorded by GamerBlurb.

beats.caption: The highest speed rating so far belongs to the Pegassi Infernus 96, at 7.1 out of 10. It's the Lamborghini Diablo-style exotic, and right now it's the pick for raw speed.
beats.tts: The highest speed rating so far belongs to the Pegassi Infernus 96, at 7.1 out of 10. It's the Lamborghini Diablo-style exotic, and right now it's the pick for raw speed.

beats.caption: Next is the Grotti Cheetah 95 at 6.6, but that one is an Ultimate Edition car, so not everyone has it. Then the Pfister Comet 88 at 6.1, the classic Porsche 911-style sports car, and a great all-rounder for everyday driving.
beats.tts: Next is the Grotti Cheetah 95 at 6.6, but that one is an Ultimate Edition car, so not everyone has it. Then the Pfister Comet 88 at 6.1, the classic Porsche 911-style sports car, and a great all-rounder for everyday driving.

beats.caption: For classic style, the Invetero Coquette 64 rates 5.9, the Corvette C2 look. The Annis Elegy 90 and the Bravado Buffalo 19 both sit at 5.5, so you get a Nissan Skyline-style car or a Dodge Charger-style four-door muscle car with the same speed.
beats.tts: For classic style, the Invetero Coquette 64 rates 5.9, the Corvette C2 look. The Annis Elegy 90 and the Bravado Buffalo 19 both sit at 5.5, so you get a Nissan Skyline-style car or a Dodge Charger-style four-door muscle car with the same speed.

beats.caption: Muscle fans get the Bravado Gauntlet Custom 69 at 5.4, the Dodge Challenger lookalike. For everyday driving, the Pfister Astron, a Porsche Macan-style SUV, and the Obey 8F Drafter, an Audi RS5-style coupe, both rate 5.3.
beats.tts: Muscle fans get the Bravado Gauntlet Custom 69 at 5.4, the Dodge Challenger lookalike. For everyday driving, the Pfister Astron, a Porsche Macan-style SUV, and the Obey 8F Drafter, an Audi RS5-style coupe, both rate 5.3.

beats.caption: And if you go off-road, especially in the Grassrivers or up near Mount Kalaga, the BF Bandito 77 is slow on the road, but its off-road score is far higher than its road score.
beats.tts: And if you go off-road, especially in the Grassrivers or up near Mount Kalaga, the BF Bandito 77 is slow on the road, but its off-road score is far higher than its road score.
beats.visual_need: off-road buggy in swamp and forest

beats.caption: Don't forget Jason's own car, the Vapid Ganado 70. It's no speed machine at 4.7, but it's his personal vehicle from the start and it's free.
beats.tts: Don't forget Jason's own car, the Vapid Ganado 70. It's no speed machine at 4.7, but it's his personal vehicle from the start and it's free.

beats.caption: One more thing: cars in GTA 6 need fuel, and electric ones need charging. A supercar with an empty tank is just an expensive statue, so keep an eye on it before a big job.
beats.tts: One more thing: cars in GTA 6 need fuel, and electric ones need charging. A supercar with an empty tank is just an expensive statue, so keep an eye on it before a big job.

beats.caption: Not every car should be kept. Moses also buys stolen cars, but only ones without a tracker, and after a sale he goes on cooldown. Sleep at a safehouse and the cooldown resets.
beats.tts: Not every car should be kept. Moses also buys stolen cars, but only ones without a tracker, and after a sale he goes on cooldown. Sleep at a safehouse and the cooldown resets.

beats.caption: Pay N Spray buys cars too, but it has a daily limit and won't take high-end cars with trackers. And later, Randy's high-end contracts pay the most of all.
beats.tts: Pay N Spray buys cars too, but it has a daily limit and won't take high-end cars with trackers. And later, Randy's high-end contracts pay the most of all.
beats.visual_need: Pay N Spray, luxury car delivery

beats.caption: So the rule is simple: tracker-free and fun to drive, keep it. Tracked, or just average, sell it.
beats.tts: So the rule is simple: tracker-free and fun to drive, keep it. Tracked, or just average, sell it.

beats.caption: Your car choice matters for crimes too. Older cars you can hotwire are safer for jobs than luxury cars, which need a cloned key and often carry trackers.
beats.tts: Your car choice matters for crimes too. Older cars you can hotwire are safer for jobs than luxury cars, which need a cloned key and often carry trackers.
beats.visual_need: old sedan at a robbery scene

beats.caption: For robberies, think about space. Each character carries two stash bags, a van or truck holds up to eight, and a motorbike holds none. Bring a bike to a jewellery job and you're leaving money behind.
beats.tts: For robberies, think about space. Each character carries two stash bags, a van or truck holds up to eight, and a motorbike holds none. Bring a bike to a jewellery job and you're leaving money behind.

beats.caption: But for escaping at three stars or more, a normal car struggles. A fast bike, or going on foot through alleys, works better.
beats.tts: But for escaping at three stars or more, a normal car struggles. A fast bike, or going on foot through alleys, works better.

beats.caption: So here's my advice. Don't burn your free registration on the first shiny car you see. Scan a few, check for trackers, and register something fast and tracker-free.
beats.tts: So here's my advice. Don't burn your free registration on the first shiny car you see. Scan a few, check for trackers, and register something fast and tracker-free.
beats.visual_need: character scanning cars in a lot

beats.caption: Sell the tracked cars instead of keeping them, use older hotwireable cars for crimes, and keep your favourite registered car clean for driving around.
beats.tts: Sell the tracked cars instead of keeping them, use older hotwireable cars for crimes, and keep your favourite registered car clean for driving around.
beats.visual_need: selling a car at a garage

beats.caption: And three mistakes to avoid. Mistake one: using your favourite registered car for a robbery. If the police spot it, the car becomes part of your heat, and the only fix is to ditch it or switch cars.
beats.tts: And three mistakes to avoid. Mistake one: using your favourite registered car for a robbery. If the police spot it, the car becomes part of your heat, and the only fix is to ditch it or switch cars.
beats.visual_need: registered sports car at a crime scene, police

beats.caption: Mistake two: smashing windows in busy streets. The alarm alerts everyone nearby, and witnesses are how the police find out about you in the first place.
beats.tts: Mistake two: smashing windows in busy streets. The alarm alerts everyone nearby, and witnesses are how the police find out about you in the first place.

beats.caption: Mistake three: falling in love with a supercar before you scan it. If it has an advanced tracker, you can't simply keep it, and you've just painted a target on yourself.
beats.tts: Mistake three: falling in love with a supercar before you scan it. If it has an advanced tracker, you can't simply keep it, and you've just painted a target on yourself.

beats.caption: Quick recap. Scan with Waink. Try the door before smashing the window. Watch out for advanced trackers. Register in Chapter 2 at Moses's garage, your first one is free. And you need a free garage spot for every car you keep.
beats.tts: Quick recap. Scan with Waink. Try the door before smashing the window. Watch out for advanced trackers. Register in Chapter 2 at Moses's garage, your first one is free. And you need a free garage spot for every car you keep.
